description: Every issuer a PCAOB-registered audit firm reported auditing via Form AP, optionally scoped to one fiscal year. Give a firm name ("Ernst & Young", "Deloitte") or its numeric PCAOB Firm ID. Use for "every issuer audited by Deloitte in 2025", "how many public companies does BDO audit".

firm.description: Firm name (partial match ok) or numeric PCAOB Firm ID.

fiscal_year.description: Restrict to engagements whose fiscal period end falls in this year, e.g. 2025.

name: pcaob_firm_engagements
